sources.title: wrldsuksgo2mars/Mistral-Large-4-EXL3-K4-Core-K6 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Full-model generation, long-context quality and serving performance are separate qualification work. A runtime must support this Mistral-native mixed K4/K6 format, retained vendor FP8 indexer, BF16 MLA kv_b, official vision and BF16 dSpark components.

sources.title: Mistral Large 4 - Mistral AI | Mistral Docs
sources.snippet: Mistral Large 4 is a state-of-the-art, open-weight, general-purpose multimodal model with a granular Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It features 52B active parameters and 1.05T total parameters, and a 1.6B vision encoder.
